implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is the mandatory first public notice of substantial acquisition; a partner must track the subsequent Regulation 31(5) detailed acquirer disclosure and any Regulation 26/27 open offer mechanics if threshold was crossed.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition within 4 trading days of crossing threshold; applies to acquisitions ≥25% of voting shares or where intent to acquire ≥25% is disclosed.
Detailed acquirer disclosure (within 10 days); must include offer price, total consideration, conditions, timeline, financing sources.
Open offer obligation if acquirer crosses 25% threshold (or acquires ≥5% in 12 months if already >25%); offer must be to all shareholders at same price.
Exemptions from open offer (e.g., intra-group transfers, allotments to founders, acquisitions ≤2% per annum) — relevant if structure involves exempted categories.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013, s. 192-196 (Board approval for acquisition of own shares); ss. 43-49 (share transfers and voting rights)
framework.note: Substantive corporate law: acquirer must ensure target's constitutional powers to sell and that acquisition does not breach statutory limits (e.g., treasury stock rules).

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Reg. 30 (material event disclosure)
framework.note: If Almondz is listed, stock exchange must be notified of substantial acquisition as material event under Reg. 30; disclosure to BSE/NSE in ~15 minutes.
